title: ArcCivs same-bounds gate profile and explicit maintenance 2026-11-01
assumptions: Source-only flat 5x5 Caledonia gate; runtime delivery and player acceptance remain separate.

Participants represent 1/3/10 settlements, not measured players. Low/base/high assume 0/1/4 new gates per settlement-day, with 0.25/1/4 active construction hours and 0/1/1 completed gates per hour; these are sensitivity inputs, not throughput measurements.
Physical materials are counted from an empty capture. Existing matching native cells are excluded by CivsMaterials.required. Old accepted receipts retain their original conditions.
Each item type, closed Stock resource, Vault, tokens and player XP is a separate unit. No SELL value, crafting exchange rate or disposable income is inferred.
Existing-gate console maintenance has no inventory, Stock, worker-cycle, skill, XP, refund or item-drop flow; it changes only an owned authored world structure.
Vault and tokens remain zero directly. Movement throughput, material acquisition time and market effects are unmeasured. Current SELL and the planned SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged.
Fresh economy ledger was not collected by the gate worker: native operations belong to the parent. The decision is limited to source-derived material sinks and zero direct currency/XP hooks.
